svg.aria-label: Full backup and restore: Feeds, starred articles, filters and settings in one file. Own updates: The app checks Brief You’s releases, never Read You’s. Signed releases: Every push to main is built and published as Brief You 0.16.2.N. Brief You Nightly: Test builds as their own app, next to Brief You. Reviewed Read You updates: Read You’s changes arrive as a pull request to review.
